title: Scale a list by a fraction
description:
Write two functions on arrays of 8-byte integers, computing in doubles:

| Function | Result |
|---|---|
| `scale_array(array, count, num, den)` | multiplies every element in place by num / den, rounding each result to the nearest whole number (ties to even, as `cvtsd2si` does); den is never 0 |
| `mean_x100(array, count)` | the average times 100, truncated towards zero; 0 when count is 0 |

`scale_array(@[10, 15, -7], 3, 1, 2)` leaves `[5, 8, -4]` (7.5 rounds to the even 8, −3.5 to the even −4).

starter.solution.asm:
scale_array:
        ret

mean_x100:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
scale_array:
        cvtsi2sd xmm1, rdx
        cvtsi2sd xmm2, rcx
        divsd   xmm1, xmm2              ; the factor num / den
        xor     ecx, ecx
.loop:  cmp     rcx, rsi
        jae     .done
        cvtsi2sd xmm0, qword [rdi + rcx*8]
        mulsd   xmm0, xmm1
        cvtsd2si rax, xmm0
        mov     [rdi + rcx*8], rax
        inc     rcx
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

mean_x100:
        xor     eax, eax
        test    rsi, rsi
        jz      .empty
        pxor    xmm0, xmm0
        xor     ecx, ecx
.loop:  cmp     rcx, rsi
        jae     .divide
        cvtsi2sd xmm1, qword [rdi + rcx*8]
        addsd   xmm0, xmm1
        inc     rcx
        jmp     .loop
.divide:
        cvtsi2sd xmm1, rsi
        divsd   xmm0, xmm1
        mov     eax, 100
        cvtsi2sd xmm1, rax
        mulsd   xmm0, xmm1
        cvttsd2si rax, xmm0
.empty: ret

hints: Work out the factor once, before the loop: convert `num` and `den` with `cvtsi2sd` and `divsd` them. Each element is then convert, `mulsd`, convert back, store.
`cvtsi2sd xmm1, qword [rdi + rcx*8]` converts straight from memory; the `qword` says how big the integer is.
